title: RaaS-issued join grant consumed by Connect, DRAFT v0.1.0, CROSS-REPOSITORY REVIEW REQUIRED
description: Connect's stated requirement for what it needs from RaaS to join a room. RaaS owns the final shape, issues the grant and owns device and tenant authorization, session validation, token creation and signing, room administration, renewal and revocation. The token is secret material: never log it, persist it or include it in a diagnostic dump. token_expires_at is information for connection handling only and does not make Connect the authority for token validity. There is deliberately no field for room administration or command authority.

session_ref.description: Opaque correlation value. Connect does not interpret Job or Run business state from it.

media_capabilities.description: Media Connect may publish locally. RaaS authorizes the grant; Connect enforces only its own local media behaviour. Audio is deferred and is not a value in v0.1.
